audit.why: Emerald+ win rate 54.05% over 1123 games matches the favoured framing already in the text.

Difficulty framing is right: Rumble owns levels 1-5 because Flamespitter (10/9/8/7/6s) out-pressures a melee with a 16s rank-1 Ruthless Predator, Renekton takes level 6 on Dominus, and Rumble retakes the game at two items. Side lane and teamfights favour Rumble because The Equalizer punishes a dash-less bruiser.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike named Dominus but gave no number, so the advice was 'respect it' with nothing to act on.
audit.why: Dominus is 120/100/80s. At rank 1 that is a two-minute window after he burns it in which Rumble's own pattern is uncontested — that is the actionable half of the spike.
audit.corrected: Spike text now states the 120s rank-1 cooldown and tells the player to force fights inside it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup was absent everywhere: Ruthless Predator at 50+ Fury DESTROYS damage shields on the target. That deletes Scrap Shield before the stun even applies.
audit.why: Riot's own description of Ruthless Predator: at more than 50 Fury he slashes three times, 'destroying damage shields on the target'. Rumble's entire defensive layer against a Renekton all-in is Scrap Shield (6s flat cooldown). Pre-shielding into a full-fury Renekton therefore throws the shield away for free — the correct sequencing is to shield AFTER the stun resolves, not before it.
audit.corrected: Stated in wants.you[1], dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and the Key Ability Interactions report line, with the 16s rank-1 / 8s rank-5 cooldown attached.
